_about: Rules for the profile status (quality.py). Approved by the owner 2026-10-15. Rules are checked in this order and the first match wins: Needs Review, Stale, Partial, Strong. Edit the numbers here; the rules themselves are in quality.py.
_stale_about: Days since the profile's pages were last downloaded and its quotes confirmed (the snapshot the profile uses), not since it was first extracted. A monthly refresh plus two weeks of slack.
_thin_about: Counts distinct pages: addresses that redirect to the same page count once.
_core_fields_about: Fields every profile should state. Pricing and tagline are left out on purpose: most companies do not publish them, so a missing value says nothing about the profile's quality.
_failed_or_weak_about: Currently tracked pages that failed to download, or downloaded with too little text, in the company's latest fetch. Pages no longer tracked are ignored.
